name: val-bench-balanced-calibration-2
description: A validation subset intended to evaluate model calibration on a balanced set of prompts; measures how well model confidence aligns with accuracy across categories. Typically used to test calibration techniques and confidence-aware decision-making for language models.
evaluation_method: accuracy combined with calibration metrics (e.g., expected calibration error, ECE)
reputation: Community-contributed Hugging Face dataset with limited visibility outside calibration/validation experiments.
